clues.question: In 1954, the very American Barry Nelson became the first person to play what very British character on screen?
Jack Lowden and Jack O'Connell recently lost out on what man of action role to Robert Pattinson?
In a 2015 interview, Daniel Craig said he'd "rather slit his wrists than play" what superspy again?
Also used in the state dessert, Texas's official state tree is what drupe-bearing member of the hickory family?
Though botanically a fruit, what pie ingredient is culinarily classified as a tree nut and often gets served candied or toasted atop salads?
Depending on where you are in the US, what sweet nut gets pronounced with a "PEE" sound or correctly with a hard "puh"?
In Diana Wynne Jones' "Howl's Moving Castle," the Wizard Suliman is trying to put his body back together from inside what anthropomorphic object?
In the Uncle Remus stories, Br'er Rabbit tricks Br'er Bear into getting him out of a trap by claiming he's being paid a dollar minute to act as what thing in a garden?
In "The Wonderful Wizard of Oz," the Wizard appoints what once-brainless companion of Dorothy to rule in his stead?
A dog spilling cornmeal created the Milky Way, according to the stories of what nation whose syllabary was invented by Sequoyah?
The primary legal challenge to the Trail of Tears was made by what Georgia tribe that's now the largest in Oklahoma?
Like the Choctaw and Chickasaw, what other Native American tribe that starts with "Ch" has artifacts on display in the "Five Civilized Tribes Museum"?
Though probably not a creature you'd expect to see swimming, what 1,200 lb animals don't have front teeth so they can slurp up marine plants?
Contracted by eating the wrong snails, there's a parasitic brain worm that's been known to kill what largest member of the deer family?
Not just for fighting or stripping bark off trees, what North American megafauna's big old antlers also help them hear?
